title: 36 Hours in Zanzibar, Tanzania
abstract: Venture off the eastern coast of Tanzania to stroll through historic Stone Town, listen to a celebrated local music genre and sample one of Zanzibar’s spectacular beaches.

title: 36 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
abstract: Take a tour on a vintage Vespa, pair a cocktail with a view and peer through a window to the past in Vietnam’s largest metropolis.

title: 36 Hours in Washington, D.C.
abstract: From flowers to fried oysters, shopping to shakes, spend a weekend exploring in the shadow of the Capitol.

title: 36 Hours in Montevideo, Uruguay
abstract: During a weekend in the capital city, sample everything from meat to music to museums.
